description: Dois estágios por personagem: 1) gerar folha de personagens → Personagens\5o ano\; 2) gerar portrait HD → _landing\chars\. Personagens sem folha de referência — usar HQ como âncora para o estágio 1.
instructions: Para cada personagem, execute os dois estágios em sequência:
1. Leia o hq_reference para identificar visualmente o personagem
2. Use o sheet_prompt para gerar uma folha de personagens limpa (3 poses, fundo branco)
4. A folha deve seguir o padrão das existentes: título 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — [TEMA]', 3 poses rotuladas, fundo branco puro
1. Use a folha gerada no estágio 1 como imagem de referência (não o HQ)
2. Leia o portrait_prompt_file para obter o prompt exato
3. Gere o portrait conforme o prompt
4. Remova o fundo (chroma-key verde #00ff00 ou magenta #ff00ff conforme especificado no prompt)
Ao concluir TODOS os personagens com sucesso, mova este arquivo para .claude/done/chars-and-portraits-batch.json

notes.faca_background: Façã é verde — use magenta #ff00ff como chroma-key para este personagem (especificado no prompt)
notes.geografina_dual: Prof. Geografina aparece em 2 temas — gere UMA vez e salve os dois arquivos de portrait (diversidade-cultural-hd.png E pais-de-contrastes-hd.png)
notes.groups: Verbão, Elinho, Toni, Lixinho, Professora Ciência, Agro 4.0 são personagens individuais. Zé+Das Graças e ?,!,. são grupos — mostrar juntos no portrait (como Max+Min no batch anterior)
notes.sheet_style: Folhas devem seguir o padrão das já existentes em Personagens\5o ano\ — fundo branco, poses lado a lado, legenda embaixo de cada pose, paleta de cores opcional no rodapé

characters.name: Verbão
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Large rectangular blue/navy animated verb-block character with face and limbs, changes clothes by tense (past=old-fashioned, present=modern, future=futuristic)
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — TEMPOS VERBAIS' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Verbão — an animated living VERB character whose body is a tall chunky rectangular block in deep navy blue — in 3 poses side by side: 1) PASSADO: wearing old-fashioned historical clothes (cape, monocle or similar), stern expression; 2) PRESENTE: wearing casual modern clothes (t-shirt, sneakers), confident smile; 3) FUTURO: wearing futuristic metallic/neon clothes, excited expression. Each pose labeled below. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, bright saturated colors, Brazilian children's educational comic book style.

characters.name: Elinho
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Animated cursive lowercase letter ℓ (special L) in blue, with eyes, arms and legs, sometimes wearing cowboy hat or surfboard
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — LETRA L' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Elinho — the animated cursive lowercase letter ℓ (the special cursive L shape) in bright blue — in 3 poses side by side: 1) COWBOY: wearing a cowboy hat, bandana around neck, thumbs in belt loops; 2) SURFISTA: holding a surfboard under arm, shaka hand gesture, relaxed smile; 3) NORMAL: upright, arms out, big friendly smile, no accessories. Each pose labeled below. The letter ℓ shape must be clearly recognizable in all poses. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, Brazilian children's educational comic book style.

characters.name: Zé e Das Graças
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Two colorful fantoche/puppet characters — Zé (urban/formal style) and Das Graças (regional/traditional style) — used to demonstrate Brazilian language variation
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — VARIAÇÃO LINGUÍSTICA' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show ZÉ (left half) and DAS GRAÇAS (right half) as fantoche/puppet characters. ZÉ: urban style, neat clothes, city look, slightly formal. DAS GRAÇAS: regional Brazilian folk style, colorful traditional clothing, warm expressive face. Show each in 2 poses: FALANDO FORMAL and FALANDO INFORMAL. Both are colorful hand puppets. Labels below each pose. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, vibrant colors, Brazilian educational comic style.

characters.name: ?, ! e .
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Three animated punctuation mark characters: ? (blue, curious, round), ! (red/orange, muscular, tall), . (gray, calm, small round) — each IS the punctuation symbol brought to life
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — PONTUAÇÃO EXPRESSIVA' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show the trio side by side — INTERROGAÇÃO ?, EXCLAMAÇÃO !, PONTO FINAL . — each in 2 emotional poses. ? (blue, question-mark-shaped body): CURIOSO and CONFUSO. ! (red-orange, exclamation-mark-shaped body, muscular): ANIMADO and SURPRESO. . (gray, round compact body, calm): TRANQUILO and SATISFEITO. Each symbol-body must be clearly recognizable as the punctuation mark. Labels below each pose. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, vibrant colors, Brazilian educational comic style.

characters.name: Toni
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Animated sound wave character — blue/purple sinusoidal wave shape with face, arms and legs, represents vocal intonation
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — ENTONAÇÃO' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Toni — an animated sound wave whose body IS a sinusoidal/wavy line shape in vibrant blue-purple — in 3 poses side by side: 1) PERGUNTA (rising wave): body curves upward at the end, curious expression; 2) AFIRMAÇÃO (flat steady wave): body is level and calm, confident smile; 3) EXCLAMAÇÃO (sharp intense wave): body has tall sharp peaks, excited open-mouth expression. Each pose shows Toni's wave body with face, small arms and legs. Labels below. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, Brazilian educational comic style.

characters.name: Façã
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Large energetic dark green creature/monster who shouts 'FAÇA!' (Do it!) — embodies the imperative verb form in instructional texts
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — TEXTO INSTRUCIONAL' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Façã — a large friendly dark green creature who embodies the imperative verb (FAÇA! = DO IT!) — in 3 poses side by side: 1) FAÇA! — arms raised in a powerful 'let's go!' pose, huge open-mouth shout, very energetic; 2) EXPLICANDO — leaning forward with one finger raised, explaining something patiently; 3) ORGULHOSO — arms crossed, satisfied smile, proud stance. Dark forest green body (#15803D), chunky and strong but friendly. Labels below. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, Brazilian educational comic style.

characters.name: Lixinho
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Animated cylindrical trash bin character — gray/silver trash can with lid-hat, eyes, arms and legs
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — LIXO QUE PRODUZIMOS' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Lixinho — an animated cylindrical household trash bin in gray/silver — in 3 poses side by side: 1) TRISTE — slouched, sad eyes, lid slightly tilted down, overflowing with implied sadness about pollution; 2) FELIZ — lid-hat tilted cheerfully, big smile, arms open in a welcoming gesture; 3) DETERMINADO — standing tall, one arm raised confidently, lid-hat upright. Has a face on the bin body, lid acts as a hat, short arms and legs. Recycling symbol subtly on body. Labels below. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, Brazilian educational comic style.

characters.name: Professora Ciência
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Female scientist/educator in white lab coat, curly gray hair, warm encouraging smile, carries clipboard
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — CAMINHO DO LIXO' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Professora Ciência — a female scientist educator in her 40s–50s — in 3 poses side by side: 1) ENSINANDO — holding clipboard, one hand raised explaining, enthusiastic smile; 2) OBSERVANDO — studying something with a magnifying glass or pointing at data, focused expression; 3) ORGULHOSA — arms crossed, warm proud smile, clipboard under arm. White lab coat, curly gray/white hair, practical clothes underneath. Labels below. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, Brazilian educational comic style.

characters.name: Agro 4.0
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Compact yellow/golden agricultural robot with wheels or tank treads, sensor arms, chest display, represents modern precision agriculture technology
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — TECNOLOGIA AGROPECUÁRIA' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Agro 4.0 — a compact yellow/golden agricultural robot — in 3 poses side by side: 1) TRABALHANDO — rolling forward with a sensor arm extended, determined expression on face display; 2) EXPLICANDO — stopped, chest display showing crop data, one arm pointing upward; 3) COMEMORANDO — both arms raised in success, display showing a green checkmark, joyful expression. Yellow/golden body (#F59E0B), wheeled/tracked, sturdy farm robot. Labels below. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, Brazilian educational comic style.

characters.name: Prof. Geografina
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Woman ~45, dark skin, large YELLOW round glasses, curly gray-streaked hair in loose bun with tiny Brazilian flags, colorful patchwork vest, pointer with small globe on tip
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — PROF. GEOGRAFINA' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Prof. Geografina — woman ~45, dark skin, large BRIGHT YELLOW round glasses (her signature feature), curly gray-streaked hair in a loose bun with tiny miniature Brazilian flags tucked in, colorful patchwork quilt vest (green/yellow/blue/red squares) over white shirt, carries a pointer with a small globe on the tip — in 3 poses side by side: 1) ENSINANDO — holding globe-pointer up, enthusiastic smile, one eyebrow raised; 2) ORGULHOSA — arms crossed, proud warm smile, flag pin visible; 3) PERGUNTANDO — leaning slightly forward, one finger raised, glasses slightly tilted, warm questioning expression. Labels below. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, Brazilian educational comic style. NOTE: save portrait as BOTH diversidade-cultural-hd.png AND pais-de-contrastes-hd.png.
